source_title: Leverage Shares by Themes Weighs In: What to Know Before the Anthropic IPO
source_excerpt:
GREENWICH, Conn. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With anticipation building around Anthropic's IPO, Leverage Shares by Themes examines what investors should know ahead of a public listing. Leverage Shares by Themes is preparing to launch leveraged and short investment products linked to Anthropic, with more details coming soon.
Anthropic, the company behind Claude and one of the most prominent developers of generative artificial intelligence models, is preparing for an anticipated initial public offering.
For investors following the Anthropic IPO, the listing would add a major AI model developer to a public-market AI landscape that has largely centered on semiconductors, data centers, networking, cloud infrastructure and power.
Much of the public-market AI investment landscape has focused on the infrastructure required to develop and operate artificial intelligence systems.
Anthropic represents a different part of that ecosystem: the development of the AI models themselves.
Its anticipated IPO would give public-market investors the ability to evaluate the company alongside other publicly traded businesses participating in the development and adoption of artificial intelligence. Among the factors investors may consider are Anthropic's competitive position, revenue growth, capital requirements, valuation and the broader development of the generative AI market.
The Leverage Shares research team examines the company and its anticipated listing in "The Anthropic IPO: What You Need to Know Before Trading It."
Read the full analysis: https://leverageshares.com/us/insights/the-anthropic-ipo-what-you-need-to-know-before-trading-it/
An Anthropic public listing could also create the basis for new exchange-traded products tied to the company's common stock.
Leveraged and inverse single-stock ETFs are designed to seek a stated multiple or inverse multiple of the daily performance of an individual publicly traded stock. These products are intended for knowledgeable investors who understand the risks associated with leveraged and inverse exposure and actively monitor their portfolios.
As Anthropic moves toward the public markets, the ETF industry is also paying attention.
Anthropic is preparing for the public markets. What follows could extend beyond the stock itself.
